reason: users.controller.test.ts scopes users by a 'state' dimension that does not exist in this app's semantic layer (dimensions are gl_code, month, leaf_key; the only scopeColumn is plant), so resolveScopeAttribute returns null and the two happy-path tests fail with 'scope value state=NSW is not a valid gold value' - the fake warehouse's state values are never consulted. The two invalid-scope tests PASS for the wrong reason: they assert a 400 for an unknown VALUE but actually get it for an unknown ATTRIBUTE, so they would still pass if value validation were removed entirely. Re-point all four at this app's real scope attribute (plant/DUB) so the happy paths work and the negative paths exercise value validation. These live in test:db, which verify.py does not run.
